amendment_path: Human Director explicit decision, new version, never edit-in-place of ratified text

authority.ratification_reason: new runtime accountability layer; must not be confused with the current build-time registry

complementary_to.note: this design EXTENDS the current ledger; it never replaces, forks, or reimplements it — one registry, one ledger semantic
complementary_to.registry_semantic: build-time provenance ledger: Git history + hash-pinned Smart Note registry + CI ledger-guards

does_not: replace, fork, or reimplement the current build-time registry or ledger-guards
introduce any token, coin, reward, or affiliate mechanism (SmartCoin-era economics are superseded)
prescribe a stack — the paper's era examples are dated; principles only
grant the governor authority to act — it watches, scores, flags, reconciles; action stays under existing authority law

follow_ups: a .truth.json emitter for Smart Note projections
a public Verify page prototype for one artifact class
a U-score pilot on one governed surface — each a separate tracked item on ratification; none implemented here (no faked enforcement)

governor.naming_note: disambiguate from the NAYA-KERNEL-LAW authority node in implementation; the governor is a verify function, not an authority grant

layers.function: identity and keys: DID-style identifiers, signatures; tiered trust unsigned -> signed -> attested
event and media capture: every action/media fingerprint timestamped into canonical JSON at creation (trust at the edge)
hash-linked streams: per-entity append-only chains, prev_hash -> curr_hash; tampering structurally visible
proof-of-record consensus: ordering + continuity + quorum mirroring; optional public-chain anchoring
access and transparency: public Verify pages + SmartStamp .truth.json manifests; agent API (/verify, /manifest, /register)

privacy.rule: PII never leaves the vault boundary; a Verify page discloses the proof, never the underlying private data

smartstamp_manifest_schema.description: SmartStamp .truth.json manifest — one signed manifest per artifact. A manifest proves what was recorded and scored, never that the content is true in the world.

uri.description: identity: URI or repo path of the artifact

evidence_refs.description: perceptual hashes / fingerprints / embedding refs supporting the classification

signatures.description: tiered per L0: unsigned -> signed -> attested

stream.description: the per-entity hash-linked stream position of this record

threshold_tau.description: the publish threshold in force when scored

u_score.description: the universal truth score with components and reason codes

smartstamp_manifest_schema.title: SmartStamp .truth.json manifest

A.description: Authenticity: is this what it claims to be, from whom it claims?
A.name: authenticity

O.description: Originality: from perceptual hashes / audio fingerprints / text embeddings
O.name: originality

S.description: Safety: policy conformance, with explainable flags
S.name: safety

u_score.explainability: every score carries reason codes; every deny/flag is reviewable — a score without reasons is not a score under this design
u_score.formula_exact: U = 0.40*A + 0.35*O + 0.15*Q + 0.10*S; weights sum to exactly 1.00; A,O,Q,S in [0,1] therefore U in [0,1]
u_score.threshold_note: policy-tunable proposed default; never hard-coded without an amendment path

u_score_evaluable.description: evaluable U-score block embedded in manifests
